message_source_quote: The Raman "white-bear steering" paper pointed to the mechanism: a *stance* (not content) contrast, injected in a band above the read layers at large dose, works because the model itself writes the concept forward.

differences.what: framing of novelty: write-up presents the stance contrast, dose, and band recipe as its own independent contribution without naming any paper as the origin of the mechanism, while the message describes the method as following a paper-described mechanism first, then building a new item set on top of it
differences.message_quote: Then made it a **new contribution**: independently constructed think/don't-think pairs over 32 novel concepts/carriers.
differences.writeup_quote: The contribution is the independent construction, the generalisation evidence, and the large-dose band-20-24 recipe.

rationale: The write-up never names any source paper; it frames the stance-contrast vector, the 20-24 large-dose band, and the whole recipe as self-constructed, only using WSB's directed_modulation item set as a point of cosine-similarity comparison to argue generalisation. The closing message explicitly credits the Raman 'white-bear steering' paper as having "pointed to the mechanism" and states the method first reproduced that paper's recipe with WSB's own pairs before generalising to new pairs, disclosure that is entirely absent from the write-up.
